title: Data Analyst
description: Collects, cleans and analyses data, then turns it into reports and dashboards that help teams decide what to do next.
sdg_reason: Data-driven decisions raise productivity (8.2) and support innovation capacity (9.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Data Analysts and Scientists)

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Builds dashboards and recurring reports that track how a business is performing and explains the numbers to managers.
sdg_reason: Better performance monitoring helps organisations become more productive (8.2) and innovative (9.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (fastest-growing: Business Intelligence Analysts)

title: AI & Machine Learning Specialist
description: Designs, trains and evaluates machine-learning models and puts them into products responsibly.
sdg_reason: AI systems drive technological upgrading (9.5) and productivity growth (8.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: AI and Machine Learning Specialists)

title: Software & Applications Developer
description: Builds, tests and maintains web and mobile applications, increasingly working alongside AI coding assistants.
sdg_reason: Digital products expand access to services (9.c) and drive innovation and productivity (9.5, 8.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 and 2.4 (fastest-growing and largest-growing: Software and Applications Developers)

title: Information Security Analyst
description: Monitors systems for threats, investigates incidents and helps an organisation protect its data and networks.
sdg_reason: Secure systems make digital infrastructure resilient (9.1) and protect people's data (16.10).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Information Security Analysts; Security Management Specialists)

title: UI & UX Designer
description: Researches how people use digital services and designs screens that are clear, accessible and easy to use.
sdg_reason: Accessible design widens access to digital services (9.c) and includes people who are often left out (10.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: UI and UX Designers)

title: Internet of Things Specialist
description: Connects sensors and devices in factories, farms and buildings, and makes sense of the data they produce.
sdg_reason: Connected equipment upgrades industry (9.4) and enables precision agriculture (2.4).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Internet of Things Specialists)

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automates how software is built, tested and deployed, and keeps cloud systems reliable.
sdg_reason: Reliable deployment pipelines keep digital infrastructure resilient (9.1).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: DevOps Engineers)

title: Process Automation Specialist
description: Finds repetitive office tasks and automates them with workflow, no-code and AI tools, then trains colleagues to use them.
sdg_reason: Automating routine work frees people for higher-value tasks (8.2) and modernises processes (9.4).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (growing: Process Automation Specialists)

title: Renewable Energy Engineer
description: Designs and manages solar, wind and storage projects, from feasibility studies to commissioning.
sdg_reason: Raises the share of renewable energy (7.2) and cuts greenhouse gas emissions (13.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Renewable Energy Engineers)

title: Solar PV Installation & Systems Technician
description: Installs, tests and maintains rooftop and large-scale solar systems; a hands-on route open through TVET training.
sdg_reason: Expands renewable energy (7.2, 13.2) through accessible technical and vocational training (4.3).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (growing: Solar Energy Installation and System Engineers)

title: Environmental Engineer
description: Assesses and reduces the environmental impact of projects, from water and waste systems to pollution control.
sdg_reason: Improves water quality (6.3), cuts emissions (13.2) and protects ecosystems (15.1).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Environmental Engineers)

title: Sustainability / ESG Specialist
description: Measures a company's environmental and social footprint, prepares ESG reports and coordinates improvement plans.
sdg_reason: Helps companies adopt and report sustainable practices (12.6) and cut emissions (13.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (fastest-growing #2: Sustainability Specialists)

title: Electric Vehicle Specialist
description: Diagnoses, maintains and supports electric vehicles, batteries and charging equipment.
sdg_reason: Supports cleaner, more energy-efficient transport (7.3, 11.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-growing: Autonomous and Electric Vehicle Specialists)

title: Nursing Professional
description: Provides and coordinates patient care in hospitals, clinics and communities.
sdg_reason: Strengthens the health workforce (3.c) and access to health services (3.8).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-growing: Nursing Professionals)

title: Elderly & Personal Care Aide
description: Supports older people and people with disabilities with daily living, at home or in care centres.
sdg_reason: Supports healthy ageing (3.8) and inclusion of older people (10.2), and recognises care work as decent work (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-growing: Personal Care Aides)

title: Social Work & Counselling Professional
description: Helps individuals and families through difficult situations and connects them to services and support.
sdg_reason: Supports mental health (3.4), social inclusion (10.2) and access to social protection (1.3).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-growing: Social Work and Counselling Professionals)

title: Smart Farming Technician
description: Operates and maintains modern farm machinery, drones and sensors to raise yields while using fewer resources.
sdg_reason: Raises agricultural productivity (2.3) through more sustainable food production (2.4).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (growing: Agricultural Equipment Operators); WEF 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-growing: Farmworkers)

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Specialist
description: Plans how goods are sourced, stored and delivered, balancing cost, speed and waste.
sdg_reason: Builds resilient trade infrastructure (9.1) and reduces losses along supply chains (12.3).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (growing: Supply Chain and Logistics Specialists)

title: E-commerce Specialist
description: Runs online stores and marketplace listings, from product pages and stock to orders and customer queries.
sdg_reason: Helps micro and small enterprises reach customers (8.3) using digital channels (9.c).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (fastest-growing: E-commerce Specialists)

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Plans and runs online campaigns across social media, search and email, and measures what works.
sdg_reason: Helps enterprises, especially MSMEs, grow (8.3) and work more productively (8.2).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (fastest-growing: Digital Marketing and Strategy Specialists)

title: Project Manager
description: Plans projects, coordinates people and budgets, tracks risks and keeps delivery on schedule.
sdg_reason: Efficient delivery raises productivity (8.2), and coordinating partners builds effective partnerships (17.17).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-growing: Project Managers)

title: Responsible AI & Governance Specialist
description: Helps organisations adopt AI safely: maps where AI is used, checks risks and fairness, keeps records and writes internal policies.
sdg_reason: Makes AI use accountable and transparent (16.6) and guards against discriminatory outcomes (10.3).
source_name: MOSTI National Guidelines on AI Governance & Ethics (AIGE), 2024; National AI Office launch, Dec 2024

title: Vocational & Digital Skills Trainer
description: Teaches practical digital and technical skills to adults and young people in training centres and workplaces.
sdg_reason: Expands technical and vocational learning (4.3) and job-relevant skills (4.4).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2023, Fig. 3.3 (growing: Vocational Education Teachers)

title: Administrative Assistant / Executive Secretary
description: Manages schedules, correspondence, records and routine office tasks for a team or manager.
sdg_reason: A large, declining occupation; reskilling pathways protect full and productive employment (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 and 2.4 (fastest- and largest-declining: Administrative Assistants and Executive Secretaries)

title: Data Entry Clerk
description: Keys and checks information in databases and spreadsheets.
sdg_reason: Routine tasks are being automated; transition support protects decent work (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-declining: Data Entry Clerks)

title: Bank Teller & Related Clerk
description: Handles cash, deposits and routine account services at a branch counter.
sdg_reason: Digital banking is shrinking counter roles; transitions protect decent work (8.5) as access to finance moves online (8.10).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-declining: Bank Tellers and Related Clerks)

title: Cashier & Ticket Clerk
description: Processes payments and sells tickets at shops, stations and venues.
sdg_reason: Self-checkout and digital payments reduce these jobs; transitions protect decent work (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 and 2.4 (fastest- and largest-declining: Cashiers and Ticket Clerks)

title: Accounting, Bookkeeping & Payroll Clerk
description: Records transactions, reconciles accounts and processes payroll.
sdg_reason: Accounting software automates routine bookkeeping; reskilling protects decent work (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.2 (fastest-declining: Accounting, Bookkeeping and Payroll Clerks)

title: Customer Service & Client Information Worker
description: Answers customer enquiries by phone, chat or at a counter and resolves routine requests.
sdg_reason: Chatbots are absorbing routine enquiries; transition pathways protect decent work (8.5).
source_name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025, Fig. 2.4 (largest-declining: Client Information and Customer Service Workers)
